import pytest

from inventory import all_products, search_products


def skus(products):
    return [product.sku for product in products]


def test_min_price_is_inclusive():
    result = search_products(all_products(), min_price=5000)
    assert set(skus(result)) == {"SKU-001", "SKU-004", "SKU-005", "SKU-007"}


def test_max_price_is_inclusive():
    result = search_products(all_products(), max_price=3499)
    assert set(skus(result)) == {"SKU-002", "SKU-006", "SKU-008"}
    assert "SKU-002" in skus(result)


def test_price_range_combines_with_query_and_category():
    result = search_products(
        all_products(),
        query="hub",
        category="accessory",
        min_price=3000,
        max_price=6000,
    )
    assert skus(result) == ["SKU-003"]


def test_price_range_respects_sort_and_pagination():
    result = search_products(
        all_products(),
        min_price=2000,
        max_price=9000,
        sort="price_asc",
        page=2,
        page_size=2,
    )
    assert skus(result) == ["SKU-003", "SKU-005"]


def test_price_bounds_allow_zero_and_empty_results():
    assert search_products(all_products(), min_price=0, max_price=0) == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("min_price", "max_price"),
    [
        (6000, 5000),
        (-1, 5000),
        (0, -1),
        (True, 5000),
        (5000, False),
        (10.5, 5000),
        ("5000", 9000),
    ],
)
def test_invalid_price_bounds_raise_value_error(min_price, max_price):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        search_products(all_products(), min_price=min_price, max_price=max_price)

```

import pytest

from inventory import all_products, search_products


def skus(products):
    return [product.sku for product in products]


def test_query_is_case_insensitive():
    assert skus(search_products(all_products(), query="KEYBOARD")) == ["SKU-001"]


def test_category_filter_preserves_relevance_order():
    assert skus(search_products(all_products(), category="accessory")) == [
        "SKU-004",
        "SKU-003",
        "SKU-006",
        "SKU-008",
    ]


def test_price_ascending_sort():
    assert skus(search_products(all_products(), sort="price_asc")) == [
        "SKU-008",
        "SKU-006",
        "SKU-002",
        "SKU-003",
        "SKU-005",
        "SKU-001",
        "SKU-004",
        "SKU-007",
    ]


def test_rating_sort():
    assert skus(search_products(all_products(), sort="rating_desc")) == [
        "SKU-007",
        "SKU-001",
        "SKU-004",
        "SKU-002",
        "SKU-003",
        "SKU-006",
        "SKU-005",
        "SKU-008",
    ]


def test_pagination_keeps_existing_order():
    assert skus(search_products(all_products(), page=2, page_size=3)) == [
        "SKU-002",
        "SKU-003",
        "SKU-006",
    ]


def test_blank_query_returns_everything():
    assert len(search_products(all_products(), query="   ")) == 8


@pytest.mark.parametrize("sort", ["newest", "", "PRICE_ASC"])
def test_unknown_sort_raises_value_error(sort):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        search_products(all_products(), sort=sort)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(("page", "page_size"), [(0, 10), (1, 0), (-1, 5)])
def test_invalid_pagination_raises_value_error(page, page_size):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        search_products(all_products(), page=page, page_size=page_size)
